what:
Competitor verification — REVERIFIED 2026-04-28 (round-8 fresh research pass, supersedes 2026-04-27 verification).

**Why this memory was updated:** the 2026-04-27 verification missed several material things and described claude-mem and engram inaccurately. Don't trust the prior framings.

**Verified state of claude-mem (thedotmack/claude-mem) as of 2026-04-28:**

- **~70k GitHub stars**, multiple releases per week, current at v12.4.x. This is the established project in the space; aide-memory is the new entrant.
- **Multi-editor**, full hook integrations for: Claude Code, Cursor (`claude-mem cursor install`), Gemini CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw. NOT Claude-Code-only. Our prior "Claude Code only" claim was wrong.
- **Capture is continuous**, not session-end. PostToolUse hook fires 100+ times during a session capturing observations; Stop hook then generates a session summary. Our prior "session-end summarization" framing missed the continuous capture step.
- **Storage: SQLite (FTS5) primary**, optional Chroma for semantic search; Bun-managed worker on a local port (37777). Our prior "Chroma + Bun-managed worker" claim inverted the hierarchy.
- **Folder Context Files are OPT-IN, default-off**. Gated by `CLAUDE_MEM_FOLDER_CLAUDEMD_ENABLED` env var. Project root is excluded by design (subfolder-only). Default claude-mem behavior is project-wide observations + session summaries, NO per-folder scoping. Our prior "Folder Context Files give per-folder timelines" framing implied it was the default scoping model; it isn't.
- **License: AGPL-3.0** (verified via package.json + LICENSE).
- **Install: `npx claude-mem install`** (manages Bun + uv automatically). Verified.
- **No git-as-sync workflow** for team handoff. No personal/shared split.

**Verified state of engram (ayvazyan10/engram):**

- **Capture: opt-in `claude-code-hook.sh` script** you copy and wire to SessionEnd. Verified.
- **Recall: 7-step retrieval pipeline** (embed → vector search → graph expand → score → rank → truncate → log) with knowledge-graph expansion + contradiction detection (5 resolution strategies). Our prior "namespace-scoped retrieval against typed memory store" was a lossy summary.
- **Storage: SQLite (default) or PostgreSQL/pgvector + HNSW vector index**. Persistent index file optional. Our prior "Local store (per-namespace)" was vaguer than warranted.
- **Memory types: Episodic, Semantic (knowledge graph), Procedural** (verified). Plus a "Working" type assembled at query time, not stored.
- **Surface: MCP-first (18 tools)** + Claude Desktop Extension via Smithery 1-click + Ollama transparent proxy + OpenClaw REST adapter + REST API + CLI + webhooks. Our prior "tool-agnostic via MCP" missed the breadth.
- **License: MIT** (verified).
- **Capabilities aide-memory doesn't have** (worth knowing, not necessarily worth pitching against): Ebbinghaus decay/GC, importance learning, embedding upgradability, streaming SSE recall, plugin system with 6 lifecycle hooks, 3D visualization dashboard.
- **No git-as-sync workflow**. No personal/shared split.

**aide-memory differentiators that survive the verification:**

- Categorized + scoped recall (the layer typology + glob scopes combo)
- Hooks pre-wired at init (six events, not opt-in)
- File-per-memory in repo + git as team-sync substrate
- **Single shared `.aide/memories/` directory across editors** (claude-mem has multi-editor support but per-editor configuration; aide-memory has one store all editors read; this is the surviving cross-tool angle)
- Personal vs shared split at the storage layer
- Local-first JSON-files-as-source-of-truth (vs DB-as-source-of-truth in claude-mem and engram)

**aide-memory differentiators that the prior verification claimed but DON'T survive:**

- "Cursor support is a differentiator" — claude-mem ships full Cursor support too. Drop this framing.
- "Claude Code only competitor" — wrong; both claude-mem and engram have broader reach (engram is fully tool-agnostic via MCP).

**Other tools to consider mentioning** (flagged by research agent, not in our docs today):
- mem0
- supermemory
- openmemory
- ConPort (memory #276 had this as the closest peer; user direction needed on whether to surface in comparison)

**Files updated this round to reflect verified state:** comparison.mdx, faq.mdx (claude-mem section), README.md (claude-mem + engram sections). Web shipped via PR #2. Parent shipped via commit 8426355 on feature/phase-1-cursor-support.

**Process note:** the prior pass (2026-04-27) and this pass diverged enough that we should treat any competitor verification as having a ~1-2 week shelf life — claude-mem in particular is shipping fast (v12.4.8 landed yesterday). Re-verify before any future launch / blog post / public claim.
why: The previous version of this memory documented a 2026-04-27 verification that, on re-verification 2026-04-28, turned out to have multiple material errors (claude-mem cross-tool reach, capture mechanism, storage primary, Folder Context Files default state). Updating in-place rather than creating a new memory so future content writers don't see two competing "verified" memories with conflicting info. Also adds maturity context (claude-mem is the established 70k-star incumbent), engram capability depth (7-step retrieval, decay/GC, etc.), and the surviving aide-memory differentiators after the corrections. This is the canonical competitor reference now.
